text:
alisha: Quick proposal for embeddings preflight/shape hints — want feedback before I spin up a PoC. TL;DR: surface a lightweight header that declares per-request vector shape so the splitter/prefetcher can make smarter decisions without blocking client changes.

ben: curious — what's the exact shape you want to expose? dims only or also count+bytes?

alisha: dims + count. header suggestion: `X-Embed-Shape: vectors=24;dim=1536;bytes_est=36864`. keeps it optional and cheap to populate on client.

chao: I like the idea. Two immediate wins: 1) avoid unnecessary splits for known-compatible shapes, 2) let prefetch/cache layer warm KV with expected kv-length. But how do we prevent spoofing/abuse?

emily: we should treat the header as a hint only. runtime decisions still verify payload size on ingest. header just affects routing and pre-splitting heuristics. if mismatch -> log and increment `embed.shape_mismatch` telemetry.

alisha: exactly. plan: header flows to preflight microservice which returns `decision: keep|split|reject` and a canonical `split_plan` when split required. clients can optionally call `POST /v1/embeddings:preflight` or include header for sync handling.

mike: preflight endpoint seems safer for large uploads. But adding a sync preflight increases round trips — what's the latency budget?

ben: preflight should be cheap (<10ms p50) if it only inspects headers and tenant quotas. heavy ops (byte counting) only on actual upload. Use cached tenant policy and shape heuristics.

chao: telemetry: we need `embed.prefetch.decision`, `embed.split.count`, `embed.bytes_in_request`, and `embed.shape.hint_present` tags. sample rate per-tenant default 1% and can be bumped for customers on Dedicated.

alisha: rollout UX: console toggle per-route called "shape-hints" with three modes: OFF, HINTS_ONLY, ENFORCE. HINTS_ONLY uses header as advisory; ENFORCE will reject on mismatch (useful for strict enterprise contracts).

emily: add migration path: default to OFF for public API, HINTS_ONLY for beta tenants, then opt-in ENFORCE via ticket. Also surface in route audit logs when hints were used to change routing.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy group=runtime-prefetch v=0.3.2 started

mike: edge case: mixed-dims arrays where clients send different dims in same request. header can't represent that. proposal: allow `X-Embed-Shape: mixed` and require preflight to return a plan with chunking instructions.

ben: right — for mixed dims, prefer server-side splitting by bytes with `split_on="vector_boundary"`. we should ensure consistent ordering so clients get deterministic routing and billing.

alisha: billing note: when we auto-split, we should attribute tokens/embedding units to the original request's tenant; but console UI needs to show expanded lines (split_count x). telemetry should include `embed.split_accounted=true` and `split_factor` to make cost reports accurate.

chao: quotas: soft quota hit behavior must be documented. If split causes more quota consumption than tenant has, policy options: 1) fail, 2) fallback to lower-precision model, 3) queue. I vote for fallback+warning for PLG users and fail for enterprise if ENFORCE set.

emily: agree. Add per-tenant policy `split_over_quota=fail|fallback|queue`. Console exposes recommended default `fallback` with a knob to set `fail` for strict tenants.

alisha: security: log only shape metadata, not payload. shape_mismatch events should be rate-limited and scrub tenant ids in public dashboards.

ben: one more operational note — update alerting: high `embed.shape_mismatch` rate should page platform SRE; also new charts in console for `prefetch_rate`, `prefetch_hit_ratio`, and `avg_split_factor` per-model.

mike: sample preflight response idea: ```json
{
  "decision":"split",
  "split_plan": [{"start":0,"end":5120},{"start":5120,"end":10240}],
  "estimated_chunks":2
}
```

alisha: thanks all. next steps: I'll draft API proto + telemetry names and PRD. will add a lightweight PoC for preflight + header handling. calling out owners: runtime=ben, preflight service=chao, console UX=emily, billing=mike.

chao: ok I'll prep the preflight schema. can we gate the canary by `shape-hints=true` flag in tenant config?

alisha: yes. will add feature flag and Console toggle.

emily: UX ask — surface a small warning in the route config when enabling ENFORCE that it may reject mismatched clients. show sample payload warnings.

ben: noted. I'll scope runtime changes and list kernel/hotpath risks in the PR. quick check: does this interact badly with the KV cache? prefetch can prime KV shards based on hint. if hint wrong, invalidate cache entry and emit mismatch metric.

alisha: perfect. I'll open a thread in #eng-platform with the PR link once ready. thanks!
